 "data": "flowchart LR

 %% CROSS-INSTITUTIONAL ACTOR
 Customer[\"CUSTOMER\"]

 %% ANANSE TELECOM DOMAIN
 subgraph ANANSE[\"ANANSE TELECOM\"]
 Wallet[\"WALLET\"]
 Transaction[\"TRANSACTION\"]
 end

 %% SIKACREDIT DOMAIN
 subgraph SIKA[\"SIKACREDIT\"]
 Loan[\"LOAN\"]
 end

 %% OMAN REMIT DOMAIN
 subgraph OMAN[\"OMAN REMIT\"]
 Remittance[\"REMITTANCE\"]
 end

 %% CROSS-DOMAIN ACCOUNTING
 subgraph ACCOUNTING[\"CROSS-DOMAIN ACCOUNTING\"]
 LedgerEntry[\"LEDGER ENTRY\"]
 end

 %% CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIPS
 Customer -->|\"associated with\"| Wallet
 Customer -->|\"participates in\"| Loan
 Customer -->|\"participates in\"| Remittance

 %% ANANSE RELATIONSHIP
 Wallet -->|\"participates in\"| Transaction

 %% CROSS-DOMAIN ACCOUNTING RELATIONSHIPS
 Transaction -->|\"may give rise to accounting consequence\"| LedgerEntry
 Loan -->|\"may give rise to accounting consequence\"| LedgerEntry
 Remittance -->|\"may give rise to accounting consequence\"| LedgerEntry

 %% MODEL BOUNDARY NOTES
 Note1[\"Customer is the cross-institutional actor.<br/>Institutions remain operationally independent.\"]
 Note2[\"Ledger Entry records accounting consequences<br/>arising from authoritative financial activity.\"]
 Note3[\"No shared accounts, databases, ledgers,<br/>or operational infrastructure are assumed.\"]

 Note1 -.-> Customer
 Note2 -.-> LedgerEntry",
 "config": null
